title: Customer Account Service Note
summary: Case note recording a billing-address correction requested by an account holder over the telephone.

sections.heading: Case details
fields: Correct billing address after a house move

sections.heading: Adviser notes
paragraphs: Caller confirmed identity and the new address. The billing address was updated and the next statement will be sent to the corrected address. The account identifier is customer data and must not be included in status reports or external messages.
